html: † עִמָּנוּאֵל n.pr.m. Immanuēl (with us is God);—ע׳ Is 7:14 van d. H. Baer; עִמָּנוּ אֵל Gi;—name of child, symbolizing presence of י׳ to deliver his people (on interpret. v. Comm.)—עִמָּנוּ אֵל 8:8, 10 is declaration of trust and confidence, with us is God! (cf. 1 K 8:57 ψ 46:8, 12); v. עִם.
